study.description: Opening-range breakouts and false breaks after the first 30 minutes of the London (08:00 local) and New York (09:30 local) opens, with daylight saving, and Study 1's reversal setups restricted to 1, 2 or 4 hours after the open or allowed any time, on ten major coins at 5 and 15 minutes over the last year. Chosen on the first eight months, judged on the last four, under futures and doubled costs.

families.idea: After the first 30 minutes of the London or New York open, trade a close through that range's high (long) or low (short).
families.name: Opening-range breakout

families.idea: After the range, a candle pokes through its low (high) and closes back inside: trade back into the range.
families.name: Opening-range false break

families.idea: Study 1's liquidity sweep of the last swing low or high, only in the chosen window after the open (or any time, for comparison).
